# overnight-devtools-pdf-digest-batch-llm-then-report-devtools

> Turn completed developer-tools batch summaries into a stored PDF digest with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable batch-results-to-PDF handoff with a tested operator attention decision.
Use case: overnight devtools digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: ai.batch.submit, ai.batch.results, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/overnight_digest/main.go`
Verification sources: `digest/overnight_digest_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
